- The FMCSA removed over 10,000 driver training providers and cracked down on non-compliant capacity, stabilizing risk pools and favoring telematics-backed underwriting for compliant last-mile fleets [2, 3].
- UPS introduced steep fuel surcharges as diesel prices surge, contributing to broader energy cost pressures and margin strain that risk deferred fleet maintenance [1, 6, 12].

- Modern claims systems can leverage vehicle damage photos to estimate impact force and injury likelihood, accelerating physical damage and injury claims handling [5].
